stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The next day, all three lunch boxes had large name stickers on them.”?
options: Repairing something can save money and reduce waste, but it can also open a small door into how things work.
The broken lights were fixed before lunch, but the teacher decided to use less screen time in future classes.
The lesson was that symbols of care are not the same as care itself.
Their teacher said it was a simple lesson: when things look the same on the outside, names can save lunch.
